name: local diffusion operator
hypothesis: A local 3-point diffusion operator can recover the planted scalar diffusion coefficient and reduce one-step held-out RMSE by more than 75% relative to persistence while showing no material gain under zero diffusion.
task: one-step synthetic scalar diffusion on a 32-point grid
proposed_method: learned scalar coefficient with 3-point local stencil
primary_metric: mean held-out RMSE relative improvement versus persistence

seed_policy.selection: fixed deterministic protocol implemented by benchmark module before observing outcomes

reporting_only_uncertainty_recomputation.notes: The benchmark already emits all per-seed trials; this pass only retained and summarized dispersion.

uncertainty: Per-seed sample standard deviations are now retained from the benchmark's existing deterministic --json trial records. These are descriptive synthetic-trial dispersion estimates; no significance or external-validity claim is made.
limitations: scalar coefficient rather than learned neural operator
no matched FNO or DeepONet-class baseline
no comprehensive runtime or peak-memory comparison
claim_boundary: Execution and bounded mechanism behavior reproduced; the >75% gate failed and no neural-operator superiority claim is supported.
